# Synthetic paper A (smoke fixture, not real data)

## Methods

In adults aged 45-64, the intervention group showed a greater reduction in systolic blood pressure at 12 months than the control group (mean difference 4.2 mmHg, 95% CI 2.1 to 6.3).

Participants aged 65 years or older were not included in this trial.

## Adherence and safety

Adherence was higher in the intervention group (78% vs 64%).

Serious adverse events did not differ significantly between groups.

## Generalisability

The findings have not been tested in primary care settings and should not be extrapolated.
